# laravelforge_site_horizon (Resource)

Manages the Laravel Horizon integration of a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site). The presence of the resource means Horizon is enabled; destroying it disables Horizon. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site to enable the Horizon integration on.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Horizon integration is enabled.
- `horizon_installed` (Boolean) Whether Laravel Horizon is installed on the site.
